name: Bonterra
description: Bonterra is a social-good software portfolio spanning fundraising and engagement, nonprofit CRM, case management, impact management, corporate social responsibility and grantmaking products.
agentUseSummary: A generic Bonterra account cannot currently be connected because Bonterra publishes separate product-specific interfaces rather than one unified customer authentication, account model or resource API for the Bonterra portfolio.

blocked.label: Connect a generic Bonterra account
blocked.description: Bonterra does not publish one portfolio-wide customer identity, authorization flow, tenant model or API origin.

blocked.label: Use Bonterra portfolio data
blocked.description: Apricot, EveryAction, ETO, DonorDrive, Network for Good and other Bonterra products have distinct contracts and cannot be safely conflated.

blocked.label: Automate private Bonterra applications
blocked.description: Relay does not collect product passwords, automate private customer UIs or reverse engineer undocumented endpoints containing donor, client or payment data.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No action can be enabled until a specific Bonterra product and its supported customer contract are selected.

runtimeSupport.description: No unified Bonterra portfolio API or remote MCP service can be mounted as OpenClaw tools.
No unified Bonterra portfolio API or remote MCP service can be mounted as Hermes tools.

providerSetup.blocker: The generic Bonterra candidate does not identify a product, while Bonterra's public interfaces are explicitly product-specific and use different authorization, tenant, resource and commercial contracts.
providerSetup.nextAction: Do not request credentials or show Connect. Process each named Bonterra product independently; reconsider a generic connector only if Bonterra publishes a unified portfolio API with a customer-authorized cross-product contract.

evidence.supports: Bonterra presents a portfolio of distinct fundraising, engagement, case-management, impact, CSR and grantmaking products rather than one generic application account.
Bonterra's public API documentation labels its endpoints as Apricot-specific and includes specialized cross-product service endpoints, not a generic customer Bonterra API.
Bonterra's pricing comparison assigns API capabilities and integrations separately to individual fundraising products, confirming that access is product-specific.
